send.purpose: Sends the composer text; the same button becomes Stop while a turn runs

stop.purpose: Stops the running turn; present only while a turn runs

new_chat.purpose: Opens a new chat in the composer

model_option.purpose: One model in the open model menu (Cursor 3.31: an option in the picker's listbox)

messages.purpose: The scrolling list of chat messages; Cursor 3.31 renders it only once the chat has a message

assistant_message.purpose: One assistant text reply inside the messages list; tool and thinking rows are also role ai, with another kind
